author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Equities are pricing a finished Fed cycle and are concentrating in mega-cap technology and semiconductors (S&P 500 4,415.24, Nasdaq 100 +2.25% on Friday, VIX 14.17) while the front end did the repricing (2Y 5.04%, +21 bps over five observations, inverted curve little changed over 20) and small caps, regional banks, energy and REITs lag. The swing factors are fiscal and political rather than monetary: Moody's negative US outlook and the stopgap fight test term premium, China exports deflation through supply-side credit, Europe stagnates, and Poland's post-election rally now has to price a politicised NBP during the government handover.
sources_policy: Only the frozen 2023-11-13 feed (tools/digest.py) and the 2023-11-13 market card (tools/showcard.py) were used for facts; every citation is an own-date headline id placed in the paragraph it supports. Numbers come from the card or from titles of headlines cited in the same part. No spot-FX levels or returns are quoted; currency direction comes only from cited headlines. No other date's feed, card, spec or draft was opened.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0031 (RBA, 'Minutes of the Monetary Policy Meeting' dated 7 November 2023): minutes of that meeting cannot have been public by the cutoff; not cited.
n0028 and n0029 (RBA hike headlines stamped 2023-11-06 08:00 UTC, before the 7 November decision); the hike is cited from n0040 and n0043 instead, and the 4.35% level is not quoted.

n1472 (CNBC, 'Dollar slips after hitting one-year high against yen', stamped 2023-11-12): unclear whether it describes Friday's session or the Monday Asian open after the cutoff; yen direction is taken from n1094 and n1215 instead.
n0180 and n0184 (China October CPI) carry date-level stamps earlier than the 9 November release; the release itself preceded the cutoff, so they are cited for direction only, without figures.
n0948 (ANZ record FY profit, stamped 2023-11-12): an early-local Australian release before UTC midnight; cited for the headline only.
US shutdown deadline date, the next US CPI date, Nvidia's next earnings date and the Sejm sitting date are not stated because no cited preview carries those dates.
The Polish reference-rate level, the RBA cash-rate level and all spot-FX levels are omitted for lack of an eligible same-paragraph source or because quoting them is prohibited.
n1591 (record fall in Polish FX reserves) is cited as reported, without asserting a cause.

n1577 (Interia: Tribunal ruling worth hundreds of millions of zloty) is not explicitly tied to the judges' pay ruling in n1605; the two are cited side by side without asserting they are the same decision.
n0127/n0135 say the Biden-Xi meeting is 'next week'; the draft names the APEC meeting without calendar wording.
